rule_hit_review.why: 'After 4 applications' matches the page study (F14: 90% subjects said skin felt brighter & glowing after 4 applications), is worded as what subjects said, and the asterisk carries a consumer-study qualifier. The 'immediately after 1 application' line next to it is the same pattern and matches F15.

tone_read: Educational and calm: the headline spells out each acid and its strength, and the copy gives clear leave-on time, frequency and sunscreen guidance. No fear, hype or exclamation marks; it sounds like Minimalist.
language_read: The concentrations (25% AHA, 5% PHA, 2% BHA, 32% total) match the product exactly and are written in pack format. Efficacy is scoped as subject-reported feel with its qualifier, and 'brighter & glowing' stays within the acceptable brightness vocabulary.
